description: This file implements command handling for managing an allowlist in a chat or messaging system, including parsing commands, resolving account IDs, reading/writing configuration, and updating pairing store entries.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID for allowlist operations, prioritizing explicit account, plugin default, context account, and default account.

methods.name: parseAllowlistCommand
methods.description: Parses raw command string into structured allowlist command object, handling actions, scope, target, and options.

methods.name: normalizeAllowFrom
methods.description: Normalizes allow-from entries, using plugin-specific formatting if available.

methods.name: formatEntryList
methods.description: Formats a list of entries into a string, resolving names if provided.

methods.name: updatePairingStoreAllowlist
methods.description: Updates the pairing store with add or remove allowlist entries.

methods.name: mapResolvedAllowlistNames
methods.description: Creates a map from input entries to resolved names.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistNames
methods.description: Resolves display names for allowlist entries via plugin.
